cp4.scope: synthetic projection/scope overhead; no full-model performance claim

measurement_limits: CP2/CP4 select a synthetic rank-0 shard on one GPU; this is not distributed CP execution.
Projection benchmark compares legacy slicing with persistent decode views using the same BF16 GEMMs, not feature on versus off.
Full-model throughput, FlashMLA, MoE, HiCache DMA, target/draft acceptance and TP2 NCCL progress are unmeasured.
Cold wall times are order-dependent and include first-use setup; they are not a controlled startup-speed comparison.
Host getter measurements isolate Python helpers and do not establish cumulative end-to-end latency.
The original 4219-request workload still requires the deployment host.
